One inlaid with the bone of the Cartusion whale, pastillion ore, or black onk?|[[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]] lists off various [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] designs to a group of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]]|<ref name="A Test of Strength">{{TCW|A Test of Strength}}</ref>}}
The '''Cartusion whale''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Whale (disambiguation)|whale]]<ref name="A Test of Strength" /> from the [[Cartusio system/Legends|Cartusio system]]<ref name="Planetnamia">{{JCFCite|url=posts/27848315|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2007-12-11|time=7:59 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170916153037/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-43|quote=I wouldn't get your hopes up re alien homeworlds, beyond simple stuff like the Planetnamian species getting a Planetnamia on the map or things Dan and I can account for with a relatively quick reference.|archivefile=File:JasonFry-JCFAtlasHomeworlds.png}}. [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', stated his intention to create [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] for numerous [[Species/Legends|species]] based on context implied from their names. This article treats the [[Cartusio system/Legends|Cartusio system]] as the location of one such [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] with regard to the Cartusion whale.</ref> whose [[Bone/Legends|bones]] were used to inlay [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilts]].<ref name="A Test of Strength" />
